endorsements.name: Gino Boudreau
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-11957
endorsements.description: Improper authorization in the temporary access workflow of Devolutions Server 2025.2.12.0 and earlier allows an authenticated basic user to self-approve or approve the temporary access requests of other users and gain unauthorized access to vaults and entries via crafted API requests.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Gino Boudreau
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-4433
endorsements.description: Improper access control in user group management in Devolutions Server 2025.1.7.0 and earlier allows a non-administrative user with both "User Management" and "User Group Management" permissions to perform privilege escalation by adding users to groups with administrative privileges.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)

endorsements.name: Gino Boudreau
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-6523
endorsements.description:
Use of weak credentials in emergency authentication component in Devolutions Server allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication via brute forcing the short emergency codes generated by the server within a feasible timeframe.

This issue affects the following versions :

  *  Devolutions Server 2025.2.2.0 through 2025.2.3.0
  *  
Devolutions Server 2025.1.11.0 and earlier
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.5)
